methodologyNotes: Covers electric guitar amplifiers (combos and separate heads) currently sold at a published US MSRP or typical street price. Excludes bass amplifiers, acoustic-guitar amplifiers, standalone speaker cabinets, and pedal/desktop modelers with no built-in speaker or power amp. Price is US MSRP or typical price in USD. amplifierType is one of tube, solid-state, modeling, or hybrid. powerWatts is the manufacturer's rated power output in watts RMS (for tube amps this is the rated clean/max wattage, not peak). speakerConfig is the built-in speaker layout as count x driver diameter in inches (e.g. 1x12); use 'none' for amplifier heads. channels is the number of independent preamp channels or footswitchable voices as counted on the spec sheet (integer). formFactor is one of combo or head. onboardEffects is a boolean: true if the amp has built-in digital effects (reverb, delay, modulation) beyond nothing. effectsLoop is a boolean: true if a dedicated series or parallel FX loop is provided. directOut is a boolean: true if the amp has a DI / USB / XLR / line recording or PA output. headphoneOut is a boolean: true if a dedicated headphone or silent-practice output is provided. weightLbs is the amplifier weight in pounds.
